info.title: ChapelCore API
info.description: Machine-readable form of docs/design/DOMAIN-MODEL.md (info.version is the model version). Every path is relative to the deployment's API base URL, {apiBase}. Schemas live next to this file in schemas/.

servers.description: The deployment's API base URL, e.g. https://api.libbynaz.org or https://example.org/api

get.description: Public. Says which checks pass, with generic messages only; server details are in the doctor report, which is never public (DOMAIN-MODEL §4).

X-Request-Id.description: The reference code for this request, the same value as meta.requestId (when there is a body) and in the server log.

503.description: Status is down. The report is still sent, so a deploy check can read which check failed.

X-Request-Id.description: The reference code for this request, the same value as meta.requestId (when there is a body) and in the server log.

default.description: Any other status. The body is an ErrorEnvelope: for example 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, 422 VALIDATION_FAILED, 429 RATE_LIMITED, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR (never with a stack trace).

X-Request-Id.description: The reference code for this request, the same value as meta.requestId (when there is a body) and in the server log.

post.description: Public, rate-limited to 10 per minute per client IP, and at most 8 KB. The server redacts the report before logging it (DOMAIN-MODEL §5.8).

X-Request-Id.description: The reference code for this request, the same value as meta.requestId (when there is a body) and in the server log.

default.description: Any other status. The body is an ErrorEnvelope: for example 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, 422 VALIDATION_FAILED, 429 RATE_LIMITED, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR (never with a stack trace).

X-Request-Id.description: The reference code for this request, the same value as meta.requestId (when there is a body) and in the server log.
